searchText: Is there any reason why `node/health` does not have a `500` code defined? In my opinion this code should be included everywhere - there's always a possibility that something very bad will happen. I presume this was overlooked when 503 was defined. Yeah, it should be there on all endpoints as an option. cool, thanks experimental beacon API support released in web3.py: https://snakecharmers.ethereum.org/web3py-meets-eth2/
